name: BACH_0113
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (97%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Models and neighbors agree on Normal (0% invasive risk) [F1], though normal_lobules is unreliable.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal 97%, Benign 2%, InSitu 0%, Invasive 0% | Strong Normal, 0% invasive |
| Conformal set | {Normal} (90% target, 90% coverage) | Single-class set at guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 36th OOD percentile, 12/12 regions [F6] | Typical, reliable image |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Same top class | Independent models concur |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Normal (93–94%); InSitu contrast (90%) [F5] | Unanimous neighbors; InSitu nearby |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 2, 7, 10) · ↓ invasive · Score -0.78 lowers risk; 0/20 spot-check is unreliable [F2] · Unreliable
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 1, 6, 7) · ↓ invasive · Text score -0.313 lowers risk; 18/20 spot-checked [F3] · Weak
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 6) · ↑ invasive · Low score (+0.262) raises risk; 12/20 spot-checked [F4] · Weak
- **HoVer-Net nuclei** (regions 4, 8, 11) · context · 9th-percentile tumor density [F7], 91st-percentile immune fraction (8%) [F8] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; deleting 3 top-risk regions drops invasive score versus random (+0.0114, 95% CI +0.0021 to +0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (+0.0008 vs random, 95% CI -0.0088 to +0.0064); leans on unreliable normal_lobules (0/20) and mitoses (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- InSitu is missed, matching 90%-similar InSitu contrast BACH_0043 (differs in lymphocytes, benign stroma/fat).
- Focal invasion exists in region 8 (7% risk, invasion +1.06) or unsampled regions.

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 8**: Inspect highest-risk region (7% risk) with infiltrating stroma (+1.06) and pleomorphism (+0.47).
2. **Regions 2, 7, 10**: Verify two-layered lobules directly; normal_lobules concept (0/20 spot-check) is unreliable.
3. **Regions 1, 6, 7**: Check tubules and region 7 lymphocytes against InSitu contrast BACH_0043.
